Its hole is centered (17.5,2.5), so original stationary coordinate is (4.5,2.5). The four preimages are (1.5,2.5),(4.5,2.5),(1.5,3.5),(4.5,3.5), giving rows3/4 and columns2/5, i.e. 14,17,20,23, only C. Exhaustive per-cell folding enumeration is saved. Colored existing grid edges cannot change which cells have a physical hole; even if intrinsic colored ink, the question asks only numbered cells pierced, so C remains uniquely correct.
